perspective:
From Alice Lim’s available perspective:

- Alice knows herself as Alice Lim, an Asian woman and dental hygienist. She and Austin Moreno are old, close friends from high school; they have different careers, often discuss personal/professional lives, and support each other.
- Alice observed Austin becoming reserved when work came up. She became concerned/curious and suspected he might be hiding something about his job performance. She invited him for coffee.
- At coffee, Alice asked if things were okay at his office. She heard Austin say it was “nothing really,” just usual ups and downs; later he said he wasn’t sure how to handle a few things at work and that it was complicated.
- Alice believed Austin might be considering a career change due to dissatisfaction at work. She felt worried and shared her own experience, asking if he had thought about changing careers and suggesting healthcare.
- She heard Austin say he had thought about a change but didn’t know what other paths to take; he asked for her suggestions. He said healthcare sounded interesting and he wanted to know more about her experiences and what it involves.
- Alice sensed Austin was hesitant because of fear of the unknown; she felt frustration and empathy. She told him about her friend Lara, who switched to healthcare in her late 30s and was happier, and encouraged him that growth comes from leaving comfort zones. Austin said that was inspiring but he worried about risks and initial struggle; he thanked her and said her support and success stories helped.
- Seeing his openness, Alice felt encouraged and hopeful. She offered to connect Austin with a career counselor and friends in healthcare. Austin said that would be helpful and appreciated the connections. Alice said she would set up a meeting for next week; Austin thanked her and said he was looking forward to it.
- After several discussions and meetings Alice participated in, she believed Austin was ready to take next steps and appreciated her help. She felt satisfaction and joy and planned regular check-ins. She told Austin she was proud of his steps; he said he felt excited, nervous, and grateful. She suggested regular check-ins; he agreed they would keep him focused and that her perspective was helpful.
- Alice does not have access to Austin’s private thoughts, hidden reasons, actual job-performance details, or any outcomes beyond what she observed, heard from him, or inferred herself.
